question: When a reactangle is divided into three equal parts, each of them turns out to be a square of area 16 cm². What is the perimeter (in cm) of the rectangle?
solution:
Given: 

When a rectangle is divided into three equal parts, each of them turns out to be a square of area 16 cm2.

Concept used:

Area of a square = (Side)²

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c4afe659b4dae9079903e6ba564c1078fabe47329f367b19a12a267f8db9182.png] 

The length of each side of the squares = √16 = 4 cm

Hence,

The length of the rectangle = 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 cm

The breadth of the rectangle = 4 cm

Thus, the perimeter of the rectangle = 2 × (12 + 4) = 32 cm

∴ The perimeter of the rectangle is 32 cm.
